system_prompt_style.note: Agent prompt templates in configs/prompt_config.py with {tools}/{tool_names}/{history}/{input} variables.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The LLM then calls a formal language parsing tool to execute the query.
env_context_strategy.note: Environment is a knowledge graph queried via tools; retrieval_bm25 used only in RAG verification step.

context_compaction.note: message_limit: int = 10 plus token-limit pruning of oldest messages.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Observation: the result of the action

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: 'Use a json blob to specify a tool by providing an action key (tool name) '

tool_count.note: Two tool yaml/py pairs shipped: complete_triple and query_knowledge_graph (StepsInKG/CompleteTriple in prompt).

edit_primitive.note: Tool registry contains only KG query and triple completion; no file-editing tool.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: """search tool yaml and return simplified json format"""
tool_schema_source.note: Schemas read from hand-written yaml files in server/agent/tools/.

protocol_standardization.note: Tooling is local yaml/langchain BaseTool; no MCP/A2A in the shown tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: We adopted ReAct’s agent framework (Yao et al., 2022)

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Given a knowledge-intensive question, we initiate our approach by deconstructing the corresponding formal query into sub-steps in natural language.
planning_granularity.note: Decomposition steps are free-text passed to the query tool, not a stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Qwen-14B-Chat (Bai et al., 2023) is responsible for all the SFT data generation and the agent backbone.
multi_agent_topology.note: A separate 7B parsing model sits inside the query tool, not as an agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: we encapsulate the knowledge completion part as a tool
delegation_mechanism.note: Sub-capabilities are tools, not delegated agents.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Administrators can (1) directly integrate this newly completed knowledge into the knowledge graph or opt for (2) further verification through RAG.
human_in_loop.note: Human review gates knowledge-graph updates after the run.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, these knowledge triples are recorded in the database.
long_term_memory.note: Conversation/message DB plus pending-knowledge store persisted across runs (server/db).

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
def save_context(self, inputs: Dict[str, Any], outputs: Dict[str, str]) -> None:
        """Nothing should be saved or changed"""
state_persistence.note: Chat history persists but no agent-run resume path found.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we utilize prompt engineering to request the model to generate the correction of knowledge triples based on retrieved relevant documents
self_verification.note: RAG verification is the same model reviewing its own completed triples.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: '... (this Thought/Action/Action Input/Observation can be repeated zero or more times)\n'
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry; only output-parser retries (OutputFixingParser).

rollback.note: No undo/revert facility; agent makes no filesystem changes.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
Thought: I now know the final answer\n'
            'Final Answer: the final answer to the original input question

cost_controls.note: History token cap; MAX_TOKENS in model_config is None by default.

timeouts.note: Request-level timeout for the chat API call.

execution_isolation.note: Servers launched locally by startup.py; no container isolation configured.

filesystem_access.note: Process runs on host with normal user permissions; agent tools themselves touch no files.

network_policy.note: No egress restriction; online LLM/search APIs called directly.

permission_model.note: Any parsed tool action is executed; no authorisation check.

tracing.note: Conversation/message rows also stored in sqlite; no per-step structured trace file.

replayability.evidence_quote:
def clear(self) -> None:
        """Nothing to clear, got a memory like a vault."""
replayability.note: No replay facility found in repo tree.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: we manually evaluated the correctness of 50 questions
eval_hooks.note: Evaluation was manual; no evaluation runner in repo tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: we added label name constraints during triple inference, regenerating triples if non-standard label names were produced
guardrails.note: Also KoPL execution wrapped to return "Failed" on errors.

target_domain.evidence_quote: leveraging knowledge graphs to address the limitations of LLMs in QA scenarios
target_domain.note: Knowledge-graph QA; closest values are research/general_tool_use.

open_source.evidence_quote: Our code 1 and video 2 are publicly available.
open_source.note: No LICENSE file visible in the tree; openness asserted by the paper.
